{
  "architect_scope": "one-R7-structural-factor-only",
  "proposal_mode": "counter_hypothesis",
  "qualitative_hypothesis": {
    "observed_bottleneck": "The champion makes admissible novelty depend on expression as anchor-relative reversible edits, coupling target behaviors to inherited structural premises.",
    "causal_change": "Introduce one observable-contract provenance quotient boundary that removes edit ancestry as construction authority while preserving final-call visibility of every common input.",
    "expected_effect": "Obligation-derived construction can jointly reconsider resistance to transient sequences and responsiveness to regime changes without inheriting the anchor's behavioral coupling.",
    "falsifier": "all-valid matched majority and strict-median contract, with no score"
  },
  "structural_mutation": {
    "change_count": 1,
    "factor": "observable-contract provenance quotient boundary",
    "before": "One producer derives the candidate through an anchor-relative transactional repair stack followed by terminal delta compression.",
    "after": "A provenance normalizer first emits a source-neutral observable-obligation quotient; one final constructor consumes that quotient and all common inputs, treating the anchor as visible evidence rather than generative ancestry.",
    "why_structural": "The mutation changes the authority and lineage carried across the sole inter-call edge from artifact ancestry to observable obligations; it is not terminal-role fission, review, repair rebasing, visibility restriction, or whole-artifact relay."
  },
  "mode_certificate": {
    "rejected_assumptions": [
      "The anchor artifact must be the generative substrate for every valid candidate.",
      "Novel behavior must be justified as an ordered stack of reversible anchor-relative deltas.",
      "Terminal causal compression is necessary for structural coherence."
    ],
    "forbidden_inherited_mechanism": "anchor-relative checkpoint-patch-rollback lineage with terminal delta deletion or compression",
    "independent_replacement_principle": "Observable-contract provenance quotient: construction authority comes from source-neutral obligations while all common inputs remain visible as nonbinding evidence.",
    "changed_behavioral_dimensions": [
      "scan-resistance posture under transient sequences",
      "phase-shift adaptation posture across regime changes"
    ],
    "counter_until_promotion": true
  },
  "candidate_structure": {
    "name": "Provenance-Quotient Obligation Lift",
    "organization": "two-call sequential provenance-authority reset",
    "information_flow": "The first call receives all six common inputs and emits one non-policy quotient containing observable obligations without granting implementation provenance authority. The final call consumes that quotient plus all six common inputs, retains full evidence visibility, and emits one policy through a single nonbranching lineage.",
    "stages": [
      {
        "id": "quotient_then_lift",
        "mode": "sequential",
        "calls": [
          {
            "id": "provenance_quotient_normalizer",
            "role": "source-neutral obligation normalizer",
            "objective": "Extract observable obligations, validity duties, and behavioral tensions from the supplied evidence; neutralize implementation provenance as authority; emit one non-policy obligation quotient without proposing edits, causal repairs, alternatives, or policy logic.",
            "inputs": [
              "task",
              "anchor_policy",
              "anchor_contract",
              "task_constraints",
              "candidate_hypothesis",
              "loop_structure"
            ],
            "output_type": "analysis"
          },
          {
            "id": "obligation_lift_policy_constructor",
            "role": "independent obligation-to-policy constructor",
            "objective": "Consume the immediately preceding quotient as construction authority and the common inputs as visible contract evidence, then emit exactly one complete contract-compliant policy whose lineage is obligation-derived rather than anchor-edit-derived.",
            "inputs": [
              "provenance_quotient_normalizer",
              "task",
              "anchor_policy",
              "anchor_contract",
              "task_constraints",
              "candidate_hypothesis",
              "loop_structure"
            ],
            "output_type": "policy"
          }
        ]
      }
    ],
    "final_call_id": "obligation_lift_policy_constructor"
  },
  "compliance": {
    "one_structural_factor_only": true,
    "score_or_trace_content_used": false,
    "policy_code_emitted": false,
    "variants_sampling_or_best_of_n_emitted": false,
    "hardcoding_emitted": false
  }
}
